decided_by: Agent session for Alexander Kell; scope L-121 and Opus review round F1/F2/F3/F5; review in PR #1127 decides
rationale: AD-422: isolate core-only dispatch and typed frame metadata; move unchanged grammar and parser UML ownership. Keep the legacy broad-exception allowance and add only the final core-only CLI error boundary required by F3. F1 hashes the exact selected contract and binds the collected root in the sole frame reader; it parses config paths, not contract rules. Measured calls_unresolved is 1069 versus 1027 on main (1060 before this review round); typing_positions is 78 versus 71 for checked JSON boundaries. No Any/getattr, unknown-position or violation budget grows. The core-to-facts edge uses existing identity helpers for raw contract digests and source locations.
